slides.heading: reverse()
slides.body: reverse() is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: reverse()
slides.body: reverse() reverses the current order of a list. It does not sort; it simply flips the order.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: reverse() is like turning a line of students around so the last becomes first.
